listingTitle: Narrow an inheritance contract subclasses reject
title: Narrow an inheritance contract subclasses reject
why: Several subclasses rejecting inherited operations indicates that the base class promises behavior those subtypes cannot honor.
suggestion: Consider composition or smaller capability-specific base contracts so subclasses inherit only supported behavior.
limitations: Requires a directly declared base class with at least four instance methods and at least two direct subclasses.
Each qualifying subclass must override and explicitly reject at least two inherited methods; at least three distinct operations must be rejected.
Indirect inheritance, partial types, mixins, and resolved overrides are not analyzed.
